episodes.title: The Perfect Mother
episodes.summary: Jess takes her baby to A&E. Liz, duty Doctor and friend, calls Social Services.

episodes.title: You Think You Know Someone
episodes.summary: The police and the social services look into the case. The group's tensions begin on holiday.

episodes.title: One of Them Is Lying
episodes.summary: As the investigation continues, cracks form and shocking discoveries are made.

episodes.title: Nowhere Safe
episodes.summary: The threat of Social Services splitting up the Carrisfords' family closes in.

episodes.title: Unravelling
episodes.summary: The group deal with the fallout of Jess' shocking actions, nearing the truth.

episodes.title: What Have You Done?
episodes.summary: The truth remains out of reach, but the summer fair leads to a shocking reveal.
